comparison: TP1/DP4, TP2/DP2, TP4/DP1 within each four-chip host. Same real held-out histories, positions and full target heads. H1 primary; H4/H8 diagnostic. Five interleaved repetitions with host barriers; aggregate maximum host latency per repetition.
numerical_contract: Unchanged trained model parameters; every head and cache length checked against a data-parallel full causal XLA forward. Parameter and KV shards must physically match the chosen local mesh. Small TPU qualification precedes full-model profiling.

primary_screen.condition: H1 at 233M, global128 sequences, full128-position prefixes and 256-position cache

scope: Target inference plus donated KV completion and head transfer, not completed rollout throughput or MFU. Cross-host inference collectives are excluded by the local-device mesh. A passing layout only permits native GTP/search qualification.
